claims: The Xbox Series X delivers 4K gaming at up to 120 FPS.
The Xbox Series X features the Xbox Velocity Architecture.
The Xbox Series X offers backward compatibility for four generations of games.
The Xbox Series X supports Game Pass Ultimate.
The Xbox Series X provides true 4K resolution gaming.
The Xbox Series X supports up to 120 frames per second.
The Xbox Series X has 1TB Custom SSD.
The Xbox Series X storage is expandable via Seagate/Western Digital cards.
The disc version of the Xbox Series X has an Ultra HD Blu-ray drive.
The Xbox Series X has Quick Resume.
The Xbox Series X plays thousands of titles across four generations (Xbox, Xbox 360, Xbox One, Series X|S).
The Xbox Series X supports 3D Spatial Sound.
The Xbox Series X is designed for vertical or horizontal orientation.
The Xbox Series X has a single fan.
The Xbox Series X has HDMI 2.1 output.
The Xbox Series X has three USB 3.2 ports.
The Xbox Series X has an Ethernet port.
The Xbox Series X includes the Xbox Wireless Controller.
The Xbox Wireless Controller has a dedicated Share button.
The Xbox Series X 1TB (Disc) is the standard model in Carbon Black.
The Xbox Series X 1TB (Digital) is the All-Digital edition in Robot White.
The Xbox Series X 2TB (Disc) is the Galaxy Black Special Edition.
The Xbox Series X is designed to work with HDMI 2.1.
The Xbox Series X enables Variable Refresh Rate (VRR).
The Xbox Series X enables Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM).
